strongest_angle: Break down the November 2026 communications loss and failure of Starfish Space's Otter 24C spacecraft during NASA's $15 million SSPICY technology demonstration mission in low Earth orbit.

key_facts.fact: Starfish Space announced that its first Otter 24C spacecraft experienced a communications loss in November 2026, bringing a 15 million dollar NASA SSPICY technology demonstration mission to a premature end one month after launch.

NASA and Starfish Space concluded that the Otter 24C spacecraft is not recoverable due to an issue where a fault protection system on the satellite blocked communications with ground operators in Tukwila, Washington.

The Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Center mission, designated SSPICY, was a 15 million dollar NASA-supported project led by Starfish Space to inspect inoperable satellites in low Earth orbit.
